violaciones.ayuda: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination

ejemplos.resumen:
Fix any of the following:
  The landmark must have a unique aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title to make landmarks distinguishable

incompletas.ayuda: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes

ejemplos.html: <div class="segmented" aria-label="Vista del inventario"><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">Catálogo</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">M
ejemplos.resumen:
Fix all of the following:
  aria-label attribute is not well supported on a div with no valid role attribute.
